(async()=>{const {useStudio}=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');const {useLiveAssistant}=await import('/src/studio/liveAssistantState.ts');const {listAssistantFiles,getAssistantFile}=await import('/src/studio/assistant/attachmentFiles.ts');if(!useStudio.getState().persistenceHydrated)throw Error('Not hydrated');const project=useStudio.getState().job.id,files=await listAssistantFiles(project);if(files.length!==22)throw Error('Stored files not restored: '+project+' '+files.length);const f=files.find(x=>x.size===524288000);const {blob}=await getAssistantFile(project,f.id);if(blob.size!==f.size)throw Error('Original missing');useLiveAssistant.setState({open:true});return {project,restored:files.length,large:f}})()
